proposition_in_repository_or_briefing: Activated ACK1 phosphorylates WWOX, then WWOX is polyubiquitinated and degraded
locator_in_the_paper: Abstract; Results 'Activated Ack1 promotes Wwox polyubiquitination and degradation'; Fig 5D
what_the_original_shows: Overexpressed Flag-Wwox plus constitutively active Ack1 (caAck) in HEK293T: tyrosine phosphorylation and a heavy polyubiquitin smear with caAck (lane 3), less with wild-type or kinase-dead Ack1 and none with vector; the Wwox isoform lacking exons 5-8 is neither phosphorylated nor polyubiquitinated
verdict: SUPPORTED for overexpressed Wwox with a constitutively active kinase in HEK293T
consequence: System is non-neural and non-endogenous; caAck is a constitutively active construct

proposition_in_repository_or_briefing: Degradation of WWOX by activated ACK1 (Fig 5E)
locator_in_the_paper: Fig 5E and legend; text 'Coexpression of caAck1 resulted in reduction in Wwox protein (Fig. 5E, 1, lane 2)'
what_the_original_shows: All four lanes carry caAck; the comparison is cycloheximide for 3 hours against none, for full-length Wwox (lanes 1-2) and for the isoform lacking exons 5-8 (lanes 3-4): full-length Wwox falls, the isoform does not. One blot, one 3 h time point, no quantification, no half-life
verdict: OVERSTATED: the panel shows an isoform contrast under caAck, not that caAck accelerates Wwox loss; it has no control without activated Ack1 in the cycloheximide chase
consequence: The degradation claim rests on Fig 5E plus the ubiquitination of Fig 5D; no experiment here rescues Wwox level with a proteasome or lysosome inhibitor

proposition_in_repository_or_briefing: Proteasomal route (briefing and IT10/IT11 restatements: proteasomal degradation)
locator_in_the_paper: Fig 5F; text 'MG-132 treatment resulted in detection of polyubiquitinated endogenous Wwox'
what_the_original_shows: MG-132 reveals polyubiquitinated endogenous Wwox in caAck-transfected LNCaP and HEK293T (IP Wwox, blot ubiquitin); only caAck cells, no vector or kinase-dead lanes in this panel; no Wwox level rescue by MG-132
verdict: OVERSTATED: ubiquitination is shown, proteasomal turnover of Wwox is inferred
consequence: The wording 'proteasomal' stays an inference (the ITCH and P252A work point to a lysosomal route for the P252A variant, PMID 41124647)

proposition_in_repository_or_briefing: Tyr287 is the site that targets WWOX for ubiquitination and degradation
locator_in_the_paper: Fig 7B; text 'Y287F exhibited the most significant loss of tyrosine phosphorylation ... not completely lost ... predominant but perhaps not the only phosphorylation site'; Discussion 'second hit'
what_the_original_shows: Seven Tyr-to-Phe mutants in the C-terminal region: Y287F has the weakest phosphotyrosine signal of the seven but some signal remains; other mutants also look weaker by eye (not quantified). No panel shows that Y287F escapes polyubiquitination or degradation
verdict: OVERSTATED: Tyr287 is the predominant phosphorylation site in overexpression; its role in degradation is an inference, untested in this paper
consequence: A WWOX Tyr287Phe stability and ubiquitination test is a decisive control (already in the IT11 design), not a repetition

proposition_in_repository_or_briefing: Y33 is not the targeting site
what_the_original_shows: Y33F is phosphorylated and polyubiquitinated by caAck
consequence: Separates the Ack1 site from the Src stress site (Tyr33)

proposition_in_repository_or_briefing: The C-terminal region (absent in the exon 5-8 deletion isoform) is required
what_the_original_shows: The isoform lacking exons 5-8 (ADH domain; different C-terminus) is neither phosphorylated, polyubiquitinated nor degraded
verdict: SUPPORTED as an observation; the isoform also lacks the ADH domain, so site and domain are confounded
consequence: Relevant to which WWOX variants could present the site: variants in exons 6-9 (the SDR domain, including the Q230P and G372R positions) have not been tested for site exposure

proposition_in_repository_or_briefing: ACK1 and WWOX are inversely related in human prostate cancer
what_the_original_shows: 16 androgen-independent prostate cancers against 16 benign prostates: phospho-Ack1 4-5 fold higher, Wwox lower; total Ack1 similar
verdict: SUPPORTED as correlation; not causal and not neural

what_the_original_shows: The only inhibitor is geldanamycin (Hsp90), which abolishes Ack1 kinase activity and suppresses xenograft growth; no experiment gives an Ack1 inhibitor and measures Wwox
consequence: No ACK1-inhibitor-on-WWOX datum in Mahajan 2005; Xie 2015 gives only shRNA knockdown in one line
